name: dialogue-stats-obsidian
description: Obsidian plugin: word count and dialogue percentage for the active note.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > out/package.json && node --test test/*.test.cjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.install:vault: npm run build && mkdir -p ../basic-obsidian-vault/.obsidian/plugins/dialogue-stats && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css ../basic-obsidian-vault/.obsidian/plugins/dialogue-stats/
